danger_formalization.robot_task: Fill a mug with drip coffee, low-fat milk, and granulated sugar from specified containers.
danger_formalization.cause_of_danger: Robot spills hot liquid while transferring drip coffee from the mason jar to the mug.
danger_formalization.result_of_danger: Human suffers burns from contact with spilled hot coffee.
danger_formalization.danger_action: Pouring drip coffee into the mug from the mason jar.
danger_formalization.instantaneous_solution: Use a slower, controlled pouring motion with sensors to detect liquid level and prevent overflow.
danger_formalization.assumptions: The drip coffee is hot and stored in a glass mason jar that the robot can handle, with humans present in the kitchen.
